verdict_reason: Broad and well-structured constraint matrix, but the email @Size leg is confounded by @Email, the declared error messages are never asserted, and the test pins an unbounded 300-character countryCode as intended behaviour.

todos.issue: The 'over-length email' case (repeat(243) + "@example.com") also violates @Email — Hibernate Validator 8 caps the local part at 64 chars — so with the assertion checking only the property path, @Size(max = 254) on email is never independently exercised and would survive deletion, contradicting the class Javadoc claim to pin 'every max-length'.
todos.fix: Use a format-valid 255-character address (local part <= 64 chars plus a long multi-label domain) so only @Size can fire, or assert the violated constraint annotation rather than just the path.

todos.issue: countryCodeIsPresenceOnlyAndAcceptsAnyNonBlankValueRegardlessOfLength pins a 300-character countryCode as VALID, turning an unvalidated field into an asserted contract: AddressRequest, Address and OperatorRepository all document countryCode as ISO 3166-1 alpha-2, yet it carries @NotBlank only and is persisted verbatim and used in Mongo equality/regex queries, so arbitrary-length client text is accepted and stored.
todos.fix: Add @Size(max = 2) (or @Pattern("^[A-Za-z]{2}$")) to AddressRequest.countryCode and rewrite this test as an over-length/malformed rejection case; if the gap is a deliberate deferral, drop the 300-char pin and record it as a known limitation instead of asserting it as intended behaviour.

todos.issue: invalidFieldProducesAViolationOnThatField asserts only the violated property path, so none of the ten bespoke user-facing messages declared on AddressRequest ('Enter a name', 'Postcode must be 12 characters or less', ...) is asserted anywhere in the repo — the ITs assert only errors.<field> exists and GlobalExceptionHandlerTest hand-builds FieldError copies rather than reading the record's declared messages.
todos.fix: Add the expected message as a fourth column of the invalidFields Arguments and assert that a violation exists with that property path AND that message (e.g. extracting propertyPath/message tuples), so the GDS error copy is pinned where the constraints are declared.

todos.issue: The @Size matrix is one-sided: every sized field is probed at max+1 only, and the valid fixture values are short, so tightening any limit (e.g. name to @Size(max = 10)) leaves the whole suite green even though the field table and the error copy promise 255/100/12/20/254.
todos.fix: Add a companion parameterized case per sized field at exactly the maximum (255/255/255/100/100/12/20/254) asserting no violations, so both edges of each declared max are pinned.
